obfuscation_indicators: no assurance financing will be available
substantial doubt about ability to continue as a going concern
risk_summary: Microbot has no operating revenue, recurring losses and negative operating cash flow, and management states that available funds support operations for less than one year. The explicit going-concern uncertainty and reliance on future equity or debt financing indicate elevated liquidity, dilution and execution risk. Extensive forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language reduce visibility into the timing and sufficiency of required funding.
